title: Journey chapter inspection
identityScope: Actual #wcCanvas and #wcJourney3d DOM identities, local-progress bridge/restart/redraw hooks, retained 3D camera/cleanup hooks, WebGL context identity, and actual mirrored progress. Renderer/scene/camera/controls objects remain private runtime closures; their object identities are not directly exposed or claimed. Camera-mode updater bridge is intentionally refreshed by reused refs.
method: Frozen actual candidate on owned ephemeral localhost server with isolated Chromium. Actual ctx.awardXP calls recorded; existing achievements pre-earned. Native Enter and Space, exact stored-state comparison excluding only two chapter UI fields, measured geometry, scoped axe. No learner tabs or port8770.
